pages.text: This tool is an extension of vanilla shears. They can be enchant to the same enchants, plus '$(6)Silk Touch$()' and '$(6)Channeling$()'$(br2)This tool is necessary when want affect more than one block at a time.$(br)
$(br)Different configurations of the mentioned enchants, along with holding the crouching key, give different effects:

$(li)$(5)No enchants, Crouch$(): Change Tinted Leaves into a brighter or darker version.$()$(br)$(li)$(5)No enchants, No Crouch$(): Cut off all Leaves and Vines on the Tree,$()$(li)$(5)Channeling, No Crouch$(): Cut off only Leaves,$()$(li)$(5)Channeling, Crouch$(): Cut off only Vines,$()

$(li)$(5)Silk Touch$(): Change all the Leaves and Vines on the Tree at once (normal -> tinted or tinted -> normal),$()$(li)$(5)Silk Touch And Channeling, No Crouch$(): Change only Leaves,$()$(li)$(5)Silk Touch And Channeling, Crouch$(): Change only Vines.$()
